part.text: The root cause: on-demand connections built via `build()`/`connectUsing()` aren't registered in app config, so when `reconnect()` → `refreshPdoConnections()` → `makeConnection()` runs, `configuration()` can't find the config and throws. I'll store the on-demand config and use it when re-making the connection.

<?php

use Illuminate\Config\Repository;
use Illuminate\Container\Container;
use Illuminate\Database\DatabaseManager;
use Illuminate\Database\Connectors\ConnectionFactory;
use Illuminate\Database\Connection;
use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;

class ReconnectOnDemandTest extends TestCase
{
    public function testOnDemandConnectionCanBeReconnected()
    {
        $app = new Container;
        $app['config'] = new Repository([
            'database' => [
                'default' => 'default',
                'connections' => [
                    'default' => ['driver' => 'sqlite', 'database' => ':memory:'],
                ],
            ],
        ]);
        $factory = new ConnectionFactory($app);
        $manager = new DatabaseManager($app, $factory);

        $connection = $manager->build([
            'name' => 'projects',
            'driver' => 'sqlite',
            'database' => ':memory:',
        ]);

        $this->assertSame($connection, $manager->connection('projects'));

        // simulate lost connection -> reconnect
        $manager->reconnect('projects');

        $this->assertSame($connection, $manager->connection('projects'));
    }
}

part.text:
Fixed. The issue was in `src/Illuminate/Database/DatabaseManager.php`: connections created via `DB::build()`/`connectUsing()` were never registered anywhere, so when a lost connection triggered `reconnect()` → `refreshPdoConnections()` → `makeConnection()`, the manager could only look up config in `database.connections` and threw `InvalidArgumentException: Database connection [projects] not configured.`

Changes (src/Illuminate/Database/DatabaseManager.php):
- Added an `$onDemandConfigs` property (src/Illuminate/Database/DatabaseManager.php:45)
- `connectUsing()` now stores the connection's config by name (src/Illuminate/Database/DatabaseManager.php:143)
- `makeConnection()` uses the stored on-demand config when present, falling back to app configuration (src/Illuminate/Database/DatabaseManager.php:177)

Verified with a reproduction test (`DB::build()` then `reconnect()` — passed) and the existing suite: `tests/Database` (2192 tests, OK) and `tests/Integration/Database/DatabaseConnectionsTest.php` (8 tests, OK). The MariaDb/MySql SchemaState tests can't run in this container due to missing `PDO::MYSQL_ATTR_SSL_CA` (no pdo_mysql installed) — a pre-existing environment limitation unrelated to the change.
